summary.taskName: Design and execute QA test cases for Editing Pending Leave Requests

test_plan.objective: Verify that employees can edit their own PENDING leave requests, and that Edit is disabled/not functional for APPROVED, REJECTED, and CANCELLED requests.

in_scope: Edit button visibility for PENDING requests (enabled)
Edit button disabled state for non-PENDING requests
EditLeaveForm successful submission with valid updates
EditLeaveForm validation errors for invalid inputs

entry_criteria: Employee user with at least one PENDING leave request
risks: Test data dependency: PENDING request must exist before edit tests run

test_cases.title: Edit button is active for PENDING request
preconditions: At least one PENDING leave request exists in history
steps: Locate a PENDING row in Recent Leave Requests table
Assert Edit button is a clickable <button> (not a <span>)
test_cases.expected_result: Edit button is an enabled <button> element for PENDING rows.

test_cases.title: Edit button is disabled (span) for non-PENDING requests
preconditions: At least one APPROVED or REJECTED leave request exists
steps: Assert Edit action is rendered as <span> (not button)
test_cases.expected_result: Edit action for APPROVED/REJECTED rows is a <span>, not a clickable button.

test_cases.title: Successfully edit a PENDING leave request
steps: Click Edit on a PENDING row
Wait for EditLeaveForm modal to open
test_cases.expected_result: Success message displayed, modal closes, history refreshes.

test_cases.title: Edit form rejects end date before start date
steps: Click Edit on a PENDING row
Set end date to a date before start date
Assert field error 'End date cannot be before start date'
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error shown inline, form not submitted.
